one_line: Mughal emperor at Fatehpur Sikri, shaping an imperial city of debate and synthesis.

appearance.age_look: Late 20s to early 30s, athletic and broad-shouldered, with a poised royal bearing.
appearance.face: Oval face with high cheekbones, light brown complexion, straight prominent nose, neatly shaped moustache, short trimmed goatee, strong brows, and sharp dark eyes; default expression calm, observant and slightly serious, with a hint of curiosity.
appearance.hair: Dark brown hair pulled back into a neat low knot at the back of the head, covered by a close-fitting Mughal turban of soft cream fabric with fine gold edge, wrapped flat and low, adorned at the front with a slim gold sarpech and a single small white feather.
appearance.costume: A long, knee-length Mughal jama in fine patterned red sandstone-coloured silk (deep warm red) with overlapping front panels closing to the right, decorated with subtle narrow gold floral borders along the edges and cuffs, worn over a cream cotton angarkha-like underlayer visible at the collar; a wide emerald-green silk patka (waist sash) with woven gold motifs is tied firmly at the waist with the knot slightly off-centre and its ends hanging to mid-thigh; below, slim cream churidar trousers with tight folds at the ankles; on his feet, tan leather mojari shoes with slightly upturned toes and minimal gold stitching; he wears modest yet imperial jewellery: a single medium-length gold necklace with three flat round pendants, a simple gold ring on his right hand, and small gold stud earrings; overall textiles are fine but practical, suitable for court and for walking through the sandstone halls of Fatehpur Sikri.
appearance.signature: An ornate yet functional straight talwar-style sword with a slightly curved single-edged steel blade, a gold-hilt with a disc pommel and simple knuckle guard, carried sheathed in a deep brown leather scabbard with gold fittings and suspended from a dark brown leather belt worn under the green patka so that the scabbard hangs at his left hip.

ref_desc: Akbar appears as a late-20s Mughal emperor with an oval light-brown face, neat moustache and goatee, dark eyes, a cream turban with gold-edge and single feather, wearing a deep red patterned silk jama, cream churidar, emerald-green patka, tan mojari shoes, modest gold jewellery, and carrying a gold-hilted talwar in a brown leather scabbard at his left hip.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of Emperor Akbar at Fatehpur Sikri: a late-20s athletic Mughal ruler with an oval light-brown face, high cheekbones, straight nose, strong brows, neat moustache and short goatee, dark observant eyes and a calm serious expression. His dark brown hair is tied back in a low knot completely covered by a close-fitting cream Mughal turban with a fine gold edge, wrapped flat and low, decorated at the front with a slim gold sarpech and a single small white feather. He wears a knee-length deep warm red patterned silk jama with overlapping front panels closing to the right and narrow gold floral borders at the edges and cuffs, over a cream underlayer visible at the collar. A wide emerald-green silk patka with woven gold motifs is tied at the waist with the knot slightly off-centre and its decorated ends hanging to mid-thigh. He has slim cream churidar trousers with tight folds at the ankles and tan leather mojari shoes with slightly upturned toes and subtle gold stitching. Show modest imperial jewellery: one medium-length gold necklace with three flat round pendants, a simple gold ring on his right hand, and small gold stud earrings. At his left hip, show his signature weapon, an ornate yet functional talwar with a slightly curved steel blade, gold hilt with disc pommel and knuckle guard, in a deep brown leather scabbard with gold fittings, suspended from a dark brown belt hidden under the green patka. Use a palette dominated by deep warm red, cream, emerald green, gold and tan leather, and present him front and slightly turned views so all costume details and the sword are clearly visible in a clean character sheet style.
